content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
ANGRAU Young Professional II Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ANGRAU Young Professional II (YP-II) recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is based on a walk-in interview. The interview is scheduled for 28 September 2026. Candidates should attend the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelors degree in Agriculture (4 years) with at least 55% marks and a Master's degree in Agriculture in Genetics and Plant Breeding division with at least 55% marks from an ICAR accredited university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates is between a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional II (YP-II) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional II (YP-II) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Young Professional II (YP-II) post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for ANGRAU recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, 522034.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their Bio-data, two sets of Xerox copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents, along with originals.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any preference for experienced candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to experienced candidates for the Young Professional II (YP-II) post.
